Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar May-06-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Darrell Salomon, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Norman Yates, who was not present at today's hearing.
No appearance by defendant Thomas Dee Engineering Co., Inc.
Default entered against defendant on December 20, 2007.
Order granting waiver of witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was filed on April 25, 2008.
Doe defendants dismissed today, May 6, 2008.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff Norman Yates, and against the Defaulted Defendant Thomas Dee Engineering Co, Inc. as follows:

Prejudgment Interest - $112.38.
Costs $220.00, for a total of $331.38.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
